repairDecisions.sourceZh: 丁未，鳳翔節度使、充西南行營都部署趙暉加兼侍中。
repairDecisions.liveBefore: On day dingwei, Zhao Hui, military commissioner of Fengxiang and overall commander of the southwestern field army, was additionally appointed Vice Grand Councilor.
repairDecisions.proposedAfter: On day dingwei, Zhao Hui, military commissioner of Fengxiang and overall commander of the southwestern field army, was additionally appointed Palace Attendant.
repairDecisions.rationale: 加兼侍中 appoints the Palace Attendant (侍中) office. Vice Grand Councilor is incorrect; jiuwudaishi/044 and the rest of this book consistently render 侍中 as Palace Attendant. Unaffected clauses preserved.

repairDecisions.sourceZh: 丁未，鳳翔節度使、充西南行營都部署趙暉加兼侍中。
repairDecisions.liveBefore: On dingwei, Zhao Hui—Fengxiang commissioner and commander of the southwestern campaign—was also made Vice Grand Councilor.
repairDecisions.proposedAfter: On dingwei, Zhao Hui—Fengxiang commissioner and commander of the southwestern campaign—was also made Palace Attendant.
repairDecisions.rationale: Same 侍中 misrendering on the idiomatic field; Palace Attendant is the established corpus reading.

repairDecisions.sourceZh: 辛未，故深州刺史史萬山贈太傅。
repairDecisions.liveBefore: On day xinwei, the late prefect of Shenzhou, Shi Wanshan, was posthumously made Grand Mentor.
repairDecisions.proposedAfter: On day xinwei, the late prefect of Shenzhou, Shi Wanshan, was posthumously made Grand Tutor.
repairDecisions.rationale: 贈太傅 grants the office 太傅 (Grand Tutor). Grand Mentor in this project is reserved for 太子太傅 and similar compounds, not a standalone posthumous 太傅.

repairDecisions.sourceZh: 辛未，故深州刺史史萬山贈太傅。
repairDecisions.liveBefore: On xinwei the late Shenzhou prefect Shi Wanshan was posthumously honored as Grand Mentor.
repairDecisions.proposedAfter: On xinwei the late Shenzhou prefect Shi Wanshan was posthumously honored as Grand Tutor.
repairDecisions.rationale: Idiomatic field repeats the same 太傅 error; Grand Tutor matches source and corpus usage for posthumous 贈太傅.

repairDecisions.sourceZh: 丙午，以皇弟興元節度使承勛為開封尹，加兼中書令，未出閣。
repairDecisions.liveBefore: On day bingwu, the emperor's younger brother Chengxun, commissioner of Xingyuan, was made mayor of Kaifeng and additionally Zhongshu Ling, but had not yet left the inner quarters.
repairDecisions.proposedAfter: On day bingwu, the emperor's younger brother Chengxun, commissioner of Xingyuan, was made mayor of Kaifeng and additionally Director of the Secretariat, but had not yet left the inner quarters.
repairDecisions.rationale: 加兼中書令 is rendered elsewhere in jiuwudaishi as Director of the Secretariat, not romanized Zhongshu Ling. Name and 未出閣 clauses already correct on the live candidate.

repairDecisions.sourceZh: 丙午，以皇弟興元節度使承勛為開封尹，加兼中書令，未出閣。
repairDecisions.liveBefore: On bingwu the emperor's brother Liu Chengxun, Xingyuan commissioner, was named Kaifeng mayor and concurrent Zhongshu Ling but had not yet left the palace.
repairDecisions.proposedAfter: On bingwu the emperor's brother Liu Chengxun, Xingyuan commissioner, was named Kaifeng mayor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat but had not yet left the palace.
repairDecisions.rationale: Concurrent 兼中書令 should follow the book's Director of the Secretariat convention on the idiomatic surface as well.

repairDecisions.sourceZh: 或曰：「可依魏高貴鄉公故事，以公禮葬之。」
repairDecisions.liveBefore: Someone said: "It may follow the precedent of the noble village lord of Wei and bury him with ducal rites."
repairDecisions.proposedAfter: Someone said: "It may follow the precedent of the Duke of Noble Village of Wei and bury him with ducal rites."
repairDecisions.rationale: 魏高貴鄉公 is the Wei ruler-title Duke of Noble Village (Cao Mao burial precedent), not a generic "noble village lord." 公 is ducal rank; 以公禮葬之 in the same sentence confirms ducal rites.

repairDecisions.sourceZh: 或曰：「可依魏高貴鄉公故事，以公禮葬之。」
repairDecisions.liveBefore: Some said, "Follow the Wei noble village lord precedent and bury him with ducal rites."
repairDecisions.proposedAfter: Some said, "Follow the Duke of Noble Village of Wei precedent and bury him with ducal rites."
repairDecisions.rationale: Idiomatic surface needs the same title reading as the literal field; "noble village lord" drops the proper title 高貴鄉公.

repairDecisions.sourceZh: 壬戌，奉太后誥，命樞密使侍中郭威監國，中外庶事，並取監國處分。
repairDecisions.liveBefore: On day renxu, following the dowager's proclamation, bureau commissioner and Vice Grand Councilor Guo Wei was ordered to supervise the state; civil and military affairs within and without were all taken at the supervisor's disposal.
repairDecisions.proposedAfter: On day renxu, following the dowager's proclamation, bureau commissioner and Palace Attendant Guo Wei was ordered to supervise the state; civil and military affairs within and without were all taken at the supervisor's disposal.
repairDecisions.rationale: 樞密使侍中 lists Bureau Commissioner and Palace Attendant (侍中); only the 侍中 gloss was wrong. Bureau commissioner and the監國 disposition clauses are left unchanged.

repairDecisions.sourceZh: 壬戌，奉太后誥，命樞密使侍中郭威監國，中外庶事，並取監國處分。
repairDecisions.liveBefore: On renxu the dowager ordered vice grand councilor Guo Wei to supervise the state with full civil and military authority.
repairDecisions.proposedAfter: On renxu the dowager ordered Palace Attendant Guo Wei to supervise the state with full civil and military authority.
repairDecisions.rationale: The idiomatic line collapses 樞密使侍中 but must not mislabel 侍中 as vice grand councilor; Palace Attendant is the required correction.
